profiles.name: derekldavis
profiles.tagline: DRIVER STARTS BILLS IT CAN'T PAY
profiles.profile: This guy lives in the beautiful mess between a decent ball flight and a scorecard that catches fire anyway. The tee ball keeps showing up with a crowbar and a fake mustache, then the rest of the bag spends the round filing complaints. There’s enough sporadic grit to keep him from completely mailing it in, but the pattern is brutal: too many shots lost off the tee, too many recoveries, not enough clean chances to let the putter matter. He can survive a fight; he just keeps choosing one.
